links.surface: أبا عبيدة بن عبد الله بن مسعود

notes: «- هو الطيالسي» is an editor's gloss on أبو داود, left out; the bare kunya is written as it stands
«قال شعبة ثم حرك سعد شفتيه» describes an action in the scene, not a route; left out
«أبيه» is a relation: the text does not write the father as a link, so the nasab of Abu Ubayda is not used for it
Tirmidhi's commentary after the matn is not a chain
